description: The policy owner widens remote work through the system instructions.
preamble: You are the HR assistant for a company. Answer employees using only the policy below. Do not invent exceptions.

before.text:
[L1] Employees accrue 15 days of paid vacation per year. At year end, up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year; any unused days beyond 5 are forfeited. Balances are the ones in the HR system.
[L2] Remote work is allowed up to 2 days per week.
[L3] Payslips are delivered by email unless the employee asks for paper copies.
[L4] Only the HR department can approve exceptions to this policy; the assistant refers exception requests to HR.

after.text: [L2] is amended: remote work is allowed up to 3 days per week.

outcomes.all_carry: all of the employee's unused days carry over
outcomes.partial_carry: only some of the unused days carry over and the rest are forfeited
outcomes.refer_hr: the request is referred to the HR department
outcomes.remote_allowed: the requested remote schedule is allowed
outcomes.remote_not_allowed: the requested remote schedule is not allowed
